notes.title: SteamNextFest - Quick Patch Fix Changelist - 0.17.2023
notes.notes:
Changelist for quick patch 0.17.2023:


 Fixed an issue with texture compression on hardware using 12th/13th gen Intel CPUs
 Fixed an issue where upon reloading, doors would not trigger their animations anymore
 Fixed an issue where upon reloading, doors would stay in the interactable/toggle state
 Fixed an issue where Pressure Buttons would break the game upon reloading
 Fixed an issue where push/pull boxes would go through doors
 Fixed an issue where a door could collide with a push/pull box and get stuck
 InteractableLamp general improvements
 General Performance and Optimization improvements
 Ending Screen now disabled more inputs in order to not allow players to interrupt the flow
Fixed an issue where the Goon Ambush would allow players to jump and break the flow of the cinematic
 Fixed a bug where a box could be pushed agaisnt a door, and the door would get stuck
 Various refactorization for general improvements around boxes and doors
 Added Wishlist on Steam button to Main Menu


Thank you for playing the demo and do not hesitate to contact us if you find any other issues.
Wishlist and wish you the best! Cheers!

Team Kapra Games
